MRP.title: MILLROSE ALERT: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Announces that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Millrose Properties, Inc. and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
MRP.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE:MRP) in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida. The complaint alleges that Millrose made materially false and misleading statements regarding its business objectives, failing to disclose that it would enter lease agreements with tenants, purchase $200 million in properties from Lennar, and lease those properties at a loss. Investors who purchased Millrose securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by December 8, 2026.

MRP.title: Millrose Properties, Inc. Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Rental Home Business and 8.5% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
MRP.summary: Millrose Properties faces a securities class action lawsuit after failing to disclose a $200 million rental home business with Lennar homes allegedly being rented at a loss. The undisclosed information caused the stock to drop 8.5% on October 2-5, 2026. Investors have until December 8, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

MRP.title: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Millrose Properties, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - MRP
MRP.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors in Millrose Properties, Gildan Activewear, and Ardelyx of upcoming deadlines to join securities class action lawsuits. The firm alleges that Millrose Properties failed to disclose material information about its business operations, including undisclosed lease agreements and property purchases from Lennar Corporation at a loss. Similar class actions have been filed against the other companies, with lead plaintiff deadlines approaching in December 2026.

NLCP.title: NewLake Capital Partners Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
NLCP.summary: NewLake Capital Partners announced Q3 2026 financial results with total revenue of $12.0 million and net income of $4.2 million. The company strengthened its balance sheet by repaying $7.6 million in debt, ending the quarter with no outstanding debt and $17.9 million in cash. Despite a 4.5% revenue decline compared to Q3 2025 due to three properties becoming available for lease, the company acquired dispensary properties in Kentucky, Michigan, and Kentucky post-quarter end, positioning itself for growth as the cannabis regulatory landscape matures.

STKH.title: Steakholder Foods Announces ADS Ratio Adjustment
STKH.summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd. (Nasdaq: STKH) announced a reverse ADS split effective November 9, 2026, adjusting the ratio from 1 ADS representing 12,000 ordinary shares to 1 ADS representing 60,000 ordinary shares. The company continues to trade on Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker 'STKH' with an updated CUSIP number. The adjustment requires no action from ADS holders.

NG.title: NOVAGOLD Shareholders Approve Transaction to Consolidate 100% Ownership of Donlin Gold
NG.summary: NOVAGOLD shareholders voted to approve a transaction where New NOVAGOLD will become the parent company and acquire Paulson Advisers' 40% stake in Donlin Gold, increasing NOVAGOLD's ownership from 60% to 100%. The arrangement received overwhelming shareholder approval with 99.72% voting in favor. The company expects to complete the transaction in Q4 2026, pending regulatory and court approvals.

VRSK.title: Fewer Cargo Thefts, Bigger Losses: Average Theft Value Jumps 72 Percent Year to Date
VRSK.summary: Verisk CargoNet reported 547 supply chain crime incidents in Q3 2026, down 33% year-over-year, but estimated losses surged to $230.1 million, up 12% from Q3 2025. Fictitious pickups now account for approximately 25% of incidents, up from 18% a year earlier. High-value thefts increased significantly, with 19 incidents valued at $1 million or more compared to nine in Q3 2025, driven by targeting of electronics and data center materials.

FOXF.title: Fox Factory Appoints Troy Henige as Chief Technology Officer
FOXF.summary: Fox Factory Holding Corp. announced the promotion of Troy Henige to Chief Technology Officer, a newly established role designed to strengthen enterprise-level technology leadership and drive innovation across the company's businesses. Henige, who previously served as Vice President of Engineering for the Powered Vehicle Group, will report to Interim CEO Doug Grimm and lead FOX's enterprise technology vision, strategy, and product roadmap.

VIVO.title: VivoPower Reports Unaudited First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results with Revenue of US$6.8 Million, Net Profit of US$0.6 Million and Positive Operating Cash Flow of US$2.1 Million
VIVO.summary: VivoPower PLC reported Q1 FY2027 results showing significant improvement with US$6.8 million in revenue (primarily from Mo i Rana data center in Norway), net profit of US$0.6 million, and positive operating cash flow of US$2.1 million, compared to a net loss of US$7.4 million in the prior year period. The company also secured US$50 million in PIPE convertible financing and announced plans to establish a separate Singapore-headquartered AI infrastructure company.

MMM.title: Raffterty Domnick Cunningham & Yaffa Responds to Historic $7.35 Billion 3M Settlement Over PFAS Exposure and Personal Injury Claims
MMM.summary: 3M Company has agreed to a landmark $7.35 billion settlement to resolve personal injury claims related to PFAS ('forever chemicals') exposure, potentially compensating 115,000 to 120,000 plaintiffs. The settlement addresses approximately 99% of existing PFAS-related personal injury claims, with payments to be made over nine years. The litigation centered on aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) used at airports and military installations, with plaintiffs alleging exposure caused serious illnesses including kidney and testicular cancers.

COUR.title: E-learning Industry Outlook 2027-2032: USD 506.6 Billion by 2032, with Instructor-led Segment Leading Growth at 12.5% CAGR, Reports Mordor Intelligence
COUR.summary: The global e-learning market is projected to grow from USD 275.9 billion in 2026 to USD 506.6 billion by 2032 at a 10.62% CAGR. Growth is driven by rising internet connectivity, corporate upskilling demand, and government-backed digital education programs. North America leads with 34.41% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows strong growth potential. Key challenges include learner engagement and limited digital infrastructure in rural areas.

ROP.summary: Roper Technologies declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.00 per share, representing a 10% increase over 2026 quarterly dividends. This marks the company's 34th consecutive year of dividend increases, demonstrating its commitment to returning capital to shareholders while maintaining its track record of compounding cash flow and shareholder value.

EG.title: INVESTOR NOTICE: Everest Group, Ltd. Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Class Action Lawsuit Before December 28, 2026 Deadline, RGRD Law Announces - EG
EG.summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announces a class action lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit claims the company made false statements about its casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves that overstated earnings. KELYB.summary: Kelly Technology + Motion Recruitment has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group for its IT contingent talent and strategic solutions capabilities. The company ranks as the sixth largest publicly traded IT staffing firm in the U.S. according to Staffing Industry Analysts, driven by growth in specialized talent delivery, AI-enabled recruiting, and expanded consulting portfolio.

NCEL.title: NewcelX Enters into Binding Term Sheet to Divest Legacy Mazindol Portfolio (CVR), Providing for Upfront Cash, Equity Ownership and Up to $55 Million in Potential Milestone Payments
NCEL.summary: NewcelX Ltd. (Nasdaq: NCEL) announced a binding term sheet to divest its Mazindol asset portfolio to REA Holdings Inc. for $500,000 upfront ($30,000 cash and $470,000 in equity representing 9.4% stake), plus up to $55 million in potential milestone payments and tiered royalties of 2-8% on global net sales. The divestiture allows NewcelX to focus on its core cell-therapy pipeline for Type 1 Diabetes while preserving potential value for CVR holders.

ETOR.title: etoro Expands into Latin America with Acquisition of Argentine Fintech LB Finanzas
ETOR.summary: eToro has agreed to acquire LB Finanzas, an Argentine all-in-one financial app, to strengthen its presence in Latin America and establish Argentina as its regional hub. The acquisition marks eToro's fourth deal in 2026, following acquisitions of Zengo, Bit2C, and TradeZero. LB Finanzas serves hundreds of thousands of users offering equities, ETFs, crypto, and money market funds across Argentine peso and US dollar accounts.

STRO.title: Sutro Biopharma to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
STRO.summary: Sutro Biopharma, a clinical-stage oncology company specializing in antibody drug conjugates (ADCs), announced that management will participate in multiple investor conferences from November through December 2026, including events hosted by Stifel, Truist Securities, UBS, Jefferies, and Piper Sandler. Live webcasts and archived replays will be available on the company's investor relations website.

RYTM.title: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals Announces NICE Guidance for IMCIVREE® (Setmelanotide) Updated to Include Adults Living with Bardet-Biedl Syndrome
RYTM.summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals announced that the UK's National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has expanded its positive guidance for IMCIVREE (setmelanotide) to include adults with genetically confirmed Bardet-Biedl syndrome, allowing NHS funding for this patient population. The expansion builds on previous 2024 guidance that covered patients ages 6-17 and recognizes the significant burden of hyperphagia and obesity associated with the disease throughout adulthood.

PHAT.title: Phathom Pharmaceuticals to Participate in November Investor Conferences
PHAT.summary: Phathom Pharmaceuticals announced that its management team will participate in three major investor conferences in November 2026: Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference (Nov 10), Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference (Nov 11), and Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference (Nov 18). The company will host fireside chats and one-on-one meetings at each event, with live webcasts and 90-day archived recordings available.

PCSA.title: Processa Pharmaceuticals Announces Key Leadership Appointments
PCSA.summary: Processa Pharmaceuticals announced key leadership appointments including Gregory J. Flesher as Chief Operating Officer, Craig Coburn as EVP Head of Research, Ashley Hall as EVP Development, and Michael P. Cruse as EVP Business Operations. These appointments follow the company's July 2026 acquisition of Vidya Therapeutics and $200 million financing. The company is advancing VT-7208, a next-generation BTK inhibitor, across Phase 2 studies in food allergy, chronic spontaneous urticaria, and relapsing multiple sclerosis, with FDA clearance recently received for the CSU study.

PMVP.title: Pivotal Phase 2 Rezatapopt PYNNACLE Data to Be Featured in Late-Breaking Oral Presentation at ENA 2026
PMVP.summary: PMV Pharmaceuticals announced that updated Phase 2 results from the PYNNACLE clinical trial of rezatapopt, a p53 reactivator for TP53 Y220C-positive advanced solid tumors, will be presented at the ENA 2026 symposium on November 20, 2026. The presentation will showcase efficacy data across multiple tumor types including ovarian, lung, breast, and endometrial cancers.

ACIU.title: AC Immune Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Corporate Update
ACIU.summary: AC Immune reported positive clinical progress in Q3 2026, with its lead Parkinson's disease candidate ACI-7104 receiving FDA Fast Track designation and showing positive safety and immunogenicity results through week-100 in the Phase 2 VacSYn trial. The company also reported positive Phase 1 results for NLRP3 inhibitor ACI-19764 and nominated a lead candidate in its small molecule alpha-synuclein program. With CHF 73.9 million in cash resources, the company has runway into Q1 2028.

GFS.title: GlobalFoundries Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
GFS.summary: GlobalFoundries announced Q3 2026 results with $1.899 billion revenue, record 31.4% non-IFRS gross margin, and non-IFRS net income of $298 million. The company secured major partnerships including a landmark U.S.-Japan initiative providing up to $21 billion in funding for two new fabs in Malta, New York, a $955 million CHIPS Act amendment, a $2 billion manufacturing agreement with TSMC for silicon interposers, and expanded agreements with Marvell and Monolithic Power Systems. Q4 2026 guidance projects $2 billion revenue with 31.5% non-IFRS gross margin.

MPWR.title: GlobalFoundries Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
MPWR.summary: GlobalFoundries announced Q3 2026 results with $1.899 billion revenue, record 31.4% non-IFRS gross margin, and non-IFRS net income of $298 million. The company secured major partnerships including a landmark U.S.-Japan initiative providing up to $21 billion in funding for two new fabs in Malta, New York, a $955 million CHIPS Act amendment, a $2 billion manufacturing agreement with TSMC for silicon interposers, and expanded agreements with Marvell and Monolithic Power Systems. Q4 2026 guidance projects $2 billion revenue with 31.5% non-IFRS gross margin.

TSM.title: GlobalFoundries Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
TSM.summary: GlobalFoundries announced Q3 2026 results with $1.899 billion revenue, record 31.4% non-IFRS gross margin, and non-IFRS net income of $298 million. The company secured major partnerships including a landmark U.S.-Japan initiative providing up to $21 billion in funding for two new fabs in Malta, New York, a $955 million CHIPS Act amendment, a $2 billion manufacturing agreement with TSMC for silicon interposers, and expanded agreements with Marvell and Monolithic Power Systems. Q4 2026 guidance projects $2 billion revenue with 31.5% non-IFRS gross margin.

XE.title: X-energy, Alleima, Doosan Enerbility Execute First Order for Nuclear-Industrial Steam Generator Components
XE.summary: X-energy, Alleima, and Doosan Enerbility announced the first procurement of steam generator tubing and helical coils for X-energy's Xe-100 advanced small modular reactor. Alleima will manufacture specialized stainless steel tubing, which Doosan will fabricate into helical coils for the steam generator. This order represents a key milestone in securing long-lead components for X-energy's first Xe-100 deployment with Dow in Texas under the DOE's Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program.

MRK.title: Medicenna Completes Phase 1/2 ABILITY-1 Enrollment and Announces Webinar to Discuss Updated MDNA11 Results with Key Opinion Leaders
MRK.summary: Medicenna Therapeutics has completed enrollment of 152 patients in its Phase 1/2 ABILITY-1 study evaluating MDNA11, a long-acting IL-2 Superkine for cancer treatment, both as monotherapy and in combination with Merck's pembrolizumab. Updated data will be presented at SITC 2026 on November 7th, with a key opinion leaders webinar scheduled for November 10th. Previous results showed objective response rates of 36% for MDNA11 monotherapy and 43% in combination with pembrolizumab.

BIXT.title: Bioxytran Secures Attested Free Sale Certification for A-SUQAR®, Opening the Path to the UAE and Gulf Markets
BIXT.summary: Bioxytran, Inc. announced that its A-SUQAR® chewable tablet has received a government-issued Free Sale Certificate for the UAE and Gulf markets. The non-systemic, pre-meal nutraceutical is designed to help manage post-meal blood sugar spikes. The certification is a key regulatory milestone for product registration in the UAE and wider GCC region, where approximately 7.5 million adults across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Kuwait are living with diabetes.

RADX.title: Radiopharm Theranostics Announces Alignment with U.S. FDA on Single Pivotal Phase 3 Trial for RAD101 in Diagnosis of Brain Metastases
RADX.summary: Radiopharm Theranostics received FDA alignment on a pivotal Phase 3 trial design for RAD101, a novel imaging agent for detecting brain metastases. The single multicenter trial will enroll approximately 280 patients and is substantially smaller than historical imaging studies, reflecting significant unmet medical need. The company expects to initiate the trial in the first half of 2027 with manufacturing support from Siemens Healthineers.

CVE.title: Cenovus announces third-quarter 2026 results
CVE.summary: Cenovus Energy achieved record upstream production of 1,024 MBOE/d in Q3 2026, generating $5.0 billion in adjusted funds flow. The company announced a definitive agreement to acquire Athabasca Oil Corporation for approximately $12.00 per share, adding ~45 MBOE/d of production and 1.3 billion BOE of reserves. Cenovus returned $1.9 billion to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks.

BDSX.title: Biodesix to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
BDSX.summary: Biodesix, Inc. (Nasdaq: BDSX) announced that its leadership team will present at two upcoming investor conferences in November 2026. The company will participate in a fireside chat and 1x1 meetings at the UBS Global Healthcare Conference on November 10 in Palm Beach Gardens, FL, and 1x1 meetings at the Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference on November 17 in New York, NY. Presentations will be webcast live on the company's investor relations website.

RPC.title: Ridgepost Capital Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
RPC.summary: Ridgepost Capital (NYSE: RPC) reported strong third-quarter 2026 results with fee-paying AUM increasing 21% year-over-year to over $35 billion. The company raised and deployed $1.3 billion in Q3, bringing year-to-date fundraising to a record $4.5 billion. Cross-selling contributed $1.7 billion to firmwide fundraising since June 2024. The Board approved a $30 million increase to the share repurchase program and declared a $0.04 per share dividend.

SFL.title: SFL - Third Quarter 2026 Results
SFL.summary: SFL Corporation reported Q3 2026 preliminary results with total operating revenues of $202 million and adjusted EBITDA of $122 million. The company declared its 91st consecutive quarterly dividend of $0.22 per share. Key developments include a seven-year charter extension for six container vessels, a newbuild order for three Very Large Ammonia Carriers, acquisition of two 8,800 TEU container vessels, and the sale of seven tankers with an expected book gain of approximately $175 million.

BEKE.title: KE Holdings Inc. to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 16, 2026 Eastern Time
BEKE.summary: KE Holdings Inc. (Beike), a leading integrated online and offline platform for housing transactions and services in China, announced it will report its unaudited Q3 2026 financial results on November 16, 2026, before U.S. market open. Management will hold an earnings conference call at 7:00 A.M. Eastern Time with dial-in options and webcast available.

JDCMF.title: JD.com to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 17, 2026
JDCMF.summary: JD.com announced it will release its unaudited third quarter 2026 financial results on November 17, 2026, before U.S. market opens. Management will hold a conference call at 7:00 am ET on the same day to discuss Q3 2026 results, with live and archived webcast available on the company's investor relations website.

TATYY.title: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. : Form 8.3 - TATE & LYLE PLC - Ordinary Shares
TATYY.summary: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. has disclosed a 1.20% interest in Tate & Lyle PLC, comprising 5,341,812 ordinary shares as of November 3, 2026. The disclosure includes a sale of 737 shares at 5.6450 GBP per unit. Dimensional expressly disclaims beneficial ownership and notes it lacks discretion over 56,848 of the shares included in the total position.

PLD.title: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. : Form 8.3 - PROLOGIS INC - Ordinary Shares
PLD.summary: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. has disclosed a 1.27% interest in Prologis Inc, comprising 12,060,160 USD 0.01 common shares as of November 3, 2026. The disclosure includes a purchase of 2,293 shares at $128.74 per unit and a transfer in of 892 shares. Dimensional also made concurrent disclosures regarding Segro PLC in relation to the same offer.

DCCPY.title: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. : Form 8.3 - DCC Energy PLC - Ordinary Shares
DCCPY.summary: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. disclosed a 1.78% interest in DCC Energy plc as of November 3, 2026, holding 1,516,595 €0.25 ordinary shares. The disclosure also noted a sale of 7,464 shares at 64.55 GBP per unit and a transfer in of 30 shares during the reporting period.

VEON.title: VEON’s Banglalink Launches Mukto Pay, Expanding Digital Financial Services in Bangladesh
VEON.summary: VEON Ltd. announced the commercial launch of Mukto Pay, a digital payments platform in Bangladesh operated by subsidiary Banglalink, following receipt of a Payment Service Provider license from Bangladesh Bank in August 2026. The platform enables money transfers, bill payments, and merchant transactions across smartphones and basic phones, with plans to introduce Bangla QR interoperable payment standard. This launch is part of VEON's 'Invest in Bangladesh NOW' initiative, which aims to attract USD 1 billion in foreign direct investment, with VEON committing USD 250 million. VEON and Square Group also received approval to establish a digital bank in Bangladesh.

MT.title: Notification of share transactions by Lumen Investments S.à r.l
MT.summary: ArcelorMittal announced on November 4, 2026, that a notification of share transactions by Lumen Investments S.à r.l., a significant shareholder entity, has been published in the Luxembourg Stock Exchange's electronic database OAM and on the company's investor relations website in compliance with EU Market Abuse Regulation.

NOK.title: Nokia Global Network Traffic Report forecasts AI will drive nearly half of global traffic in 2035
NOK.summary: Nokia's Global Network Traffic Report projects that AI will drive 44% of global network traffic by 2035, with total traffic nearly quadrupling to 3,789 exabytes per month. Physical and agentic AI applications will significantly increase demand for uplink capacity, low latency, and distributed edge infrastructure, requiring networks to be redesigned beyond traditional download-focused architectures.

CRARY.title: CREDIT AGRICOLE S.A. ANNOUNCES REDEMPTION OF GBP 750,000,000 Senior Non-Preferred Callable Fixed Rate Resettable Notes issued on November 29, 2022 (ISIN: FR001400E920)*
CRARY.summary: Crédit Agricole S.A. announced the redemption of GBP 750 million in Senior Non-Preferred Callable Fixed Rate Resettable Notes on November 29, 2026. The redemption will be executed at the outstanding nominal amount plus accrued interest, with payment to noteholders on November 30, 2026 due to the redemption date falling on a non-business day.

CRARY.title: CREDIT AGRICOLE S.A. ANNONCE LE REMBOURSEMENT DE SES  Obligations SNP Remboursables par Anticipation à Taux Fixe Révisable émises le 29 novembre 2022 pour un montant nominal total de 750.000.000 livres sterling (ISIN: FR001400E920)*
CRARY.summary: Crédit Agricole S.A. announced on November 4, 2026, the early redemption of its Senior Non-Preferred Callable Fixed Rate Bonds issued on November 29, 2022, with a nominal amount of 750 million British pounds (ISIN: FR001400E920). The redemption will take effect on November 29, 2026, with payment to bondholders on November 30, 2026, following the terms and conditions outlined in the bond prospectus.

SAXPY.title: Sampo Oyj mitätöi hankkimiaan omia osakkeita
SAXPY.summary: Sampo Oyj has cancelled 37.8 million of its own A-shares following a buyback program conducted between May and September 2026. The cancellation reduces the total number of A-shares by 1.42% but does not affect the company's share capital. Since October 2021, Sampo has repurchased and cancelled approximately 400 million shares, representing 14.4% of the total shares outstanding at the start of the first buyback program.

SXYAY.title: SIKA TREIBT WACHSTUM IM TUNNEL- UND BERGBAU DURCH PARTNERSCHAFT MIT INDUSTRYOS VORAN
SXYAY.summary: Sika has signed a partnership agreement with Australian IoT developer IndustryOS to become the global distribution partner for Safecrete and Safewall sensor technologies. These solutions enable real-time monitoring of shotcrete strength in underground construction, enhancing safety, quality, and productivity. The partnership supports Sika's digital transformation strategy and capitalizes on attractive long-term growth opportunities in tunnel and mining markets, with a global tunnel project pipeline valued at USD 1.25 trillion.

OIM.title: Solvay third quarter 2026 results
OIM.summary: Solvay reported Q3 2026 underlying net sales of €1,031 million, down 3.3% organically, with EBITDA margin declining to 16.8% due to Middle East conflict impacts and weakness in soda ash markets. The company signed a long-term rare earth feedstock supply agreement with Viridis and continues discussions with OneIM for a potential rare earths joint venture. Structural cost savings reached €283 million toward a €300 million target, while the board approved a stable interim dividend of €0.97 per share.

OIM.title: Solvay: résultats du troisième trimestre 2026
OIM.summary: Solvay reported Q3 2026 results showing a 3.3% organic revenue decline to €1,031 million and EBITDA margin compression to 16.8%, primarily due to Middle East conflict impacts on its Jubail Peroxides facility and weak soda carbonate markets. The company signed a long-term rare earth supply agreement with Viridis and continues discussions with OneIM for a rare earth joint venture. Solvay maintained its dividend at €0.97 per share and revised 2026 guidance to €720-740 million EBITDA and €120-150 million free cash flow, while progressing toward €300 million in structural cost savings.

OIM.summary: Solvay reports Q3 2026 results with underlying net revenue of €1,031 million (down 3.3% organically) and EBITDA of €173 million (down 26.6%), significantly impacted by Middle East conflict affecting its Jubail Peroxides facility. The company maintains its strategic transformation with a long-term supply agreement with Viridis for rare earth metals and ongoing negotiations with OneIM. DSFIY.title: dsm-firmenich reports Q3 2026 trading update
DSFIY.summary: dsm-firmenich delivered Q3 2026 like-for-like sales growth of 5%, consistent with year-to-date performance, with Adjusted EBITDA margin expanding sequentially to 20.4%. The company raised its FY 2026 outlook for LFL sales growth to around 5% (from 2-4%) and completed a €540 million share repurchase program. All three business units contributed positively, with Perfumery & Beauty leading at 8% growth.

STM.title: STMicroelectronics annonce sa plateforme de microcontrôleurs unifiée, conçue pour répondre à la convergence technologique des applications industrielles, automobiles et d’IA physique
STM.summary: STMicroelectronics unveiled a unified STM32 microcontroller platform designed to enable software and architecture reuse across industrial, automotive, and robotics applications. The new STM32A family extends the platform to automotive and safety-critical systems, supporting software-defined systems and physical AI. Three initial STM32A microcontrollers are sampling with broader availability expected in 2027.

STM.title: STM32 Summit 2026: STMicroelectronics announces its unified MCU platform, addressing technology convergence across industrial, automotive and physical AI applications
STM.summary: STMicroelectronics announced a unified STM32 microcontroller platform spanning industrial, automotive, and robotics applications. The new STM32A family extends the platform into high-safety and automotive systems, enabling developers to reuse architectures, software, and tools across domains while supporting physical AI applications. The first three STM32A microcontrollers are sampling to customers with broader availability planned for 2027.

ARM.title: STM32 Summit 2026: STMicroelectronics announces its unified MCU platform, addressing technology convergence across industrial, automotive and physical AI applications
ARM.summary: STMicroelectronics announced a unified STM32 microcontroller platform spanning industrial, automotive, and robotics applications. The new STM32A family extends the platform into high-safety and automotive systems, enabling developers to reuse architectures, software, and tools across domains while supporting physical AI applications. ENSG.title: The Ensign Group, Inc. Notice of December 7, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
ENSG.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against The Ensign Group, Inc. for investors who purchased shares between February 10, 2022 and June 18, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Ensign made materially false statements and failed to disclose systematic neglect of elderly residents, abuse, Medicaid/Medicare fraud, falsification of nursing assistant hours, and illegal licensing schemes. The application deadline to request lead plaintiff status is December 7, 2026.

ENSG.title: Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. Notice of November 23, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
ENSG.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announced multiple class action securities lawsuits against publicly traded companies. Honeywell Aerospace faces allegations of failing to disclose supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, cybersecurity investigation, and making misleading statements about business prospects. The Ensign Group and Duolingo also have pending securities fraud lawsuits with application deadlines in December 2026.

CC.title: The Chemours Company Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Overstatement of Refrigerant Aftermarket Demand and 18% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
CC.summary: Chemours faces a securities class action lawsuit for failing to disclose material information about refrigerant aftermarket demand during February-August 2026. The company cut full-year EBITDA guidance and admitted to channel oversupply, resulting in an 18.63% stock price decline on August 5, 2026. Investors have until December 7, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

LEN.title: Millrose Properties, Inc. Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Rental Home Business and 8.5% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
LEN.summary: Millrose Properties faces a securities class action lawsuit after failing to disclose a $200 million rental home business with Lennar homes allegedly being rented at a loss. The undisclosed information caused the stock to drop 8.5% on October 2-5, 2026. Investors have until December 8, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

LEN-B.title: Millrose Properties, Inc. Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Rental Home Business and 8.5% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC

MIST.title: Milestone Pharmaceuticals Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
MIST.summary: Milestone Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Nasdaq: MIST) granted 33,000 stock options to a new employee as a hiring inducement. The options have an exercise price of $0.72 per share and vest over four years, with 25% vesting after one year followed by monthly installments. The grant was made under the company's 2021 Inducement Plan in compliance with Nasdaq regulations.

ARDX.title: ARDELYX DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Ardelyx, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - ARDX
ARDX.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Ardelyx, Inc. for allegedly providing false and misleading statements to investors regarding the commercial performance and growth prospects of its drugs XPHOZAH and IBSRELA. The lawsuit claims defendants concealed material facts about payer-related access barriers, prior authorization requirements, and step edit requirements that hindered patient access. Investors who purchased stock between January 13, 2025 and August 6, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

ARDX.title: HONA FINAL DEADLINE: ROSEN, TOP RANKED GLOBAL COUNSEL, Encourages Honeywell Aerospace Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - HONA
ARDX.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about multiple securities class action lawsuits. The primary case involves Honeywell Aerospace Inc. (HONA), where the firm alleges the company made false statements regarding supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, and undisclosed government contract investigations. Similar class actions have been filed against Gildan Activewear Inc. (GIL) and Ardelyx, Inc. (ARDX). Investors have until November 23, 2026 to become lead plaintiffs.

ARDX.title: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Triller Group Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - ILLR
ARDX.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors in Triller Group Inc., Gildan Activewear Inc., and Ardelyx Inc. of upcoming deadlines to join securities class action lawsuits. The lawsuits allege that these companies made materially false and misleading statements regarding financial controls, business operations, and regulatory compliance.
